Messages.Author: Frederic Genest
Messages.Body:
Hi.

Just wondering how cards such as Rant and Mob Rule integrate when
stacked?

Rant
Action Modifier. Requires an anarch, only usable during a referendum,
before
any votes are cast.
During this referendum, every anarch vampire may burn 1 blood to gain
one
vote. If the referendum fails, acting vampire gets 2 unpreventable
damage

Mob Rule
Action Modifier OR Reaction
This card can be played as an action modifier card or a reaction card.
Only
usable during a referendum.
Each vampire with a capacity above 4 can burn blood to gain votes. A
vampire
gains 1 vote for each blood he or she burns. A vampire with a capacity
above
7 gains an additional vote for each blood he or she burns.

(I've sniped the text from the 'group)

Both cards basically says "burn a blood to gain a vote".

My question is: if stacked, and I burn a blood, do I get 1 vote for
each effect? Or do I have to decide my burnt blood takes effect
according to Rant or MR?

Quite possibly no, but now that we have multiple ways to get votes by
burning blood which are going to be easy to stack (including Stephano
Giovanni and Sundown specials; but not Awe as it works slightly
differently), I think it becomes more problematic.

Thanks.
Frederic.
